faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur is 28th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc/M.Tech in relevant fields with at least 60% marks and a valid GATE/NET score, or a B.Tech/B.E with 80% marks and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 48,100 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIEST Shibpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIEST Shibpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.
